title: PricePoint
description: Estimating laptop resale value from hardware, age, and condition, using data from Bangladesh’s secondhand market.
cardSummary: Estimates a used laptop’s resale price from its age, condition, and specifications, using local market data.

title: RouteGPT
description: A conversational assistant for Dhaka transport routes, transfer points, and fares, backed by a relational database.
highlights: Routes, stops, and fares in MySQL
cardSummary: Helps people find routes, transfer points, and fares in Dhaka by asking questions in everyday language.

title: MicroTeach
description: A peer teaching platform where students post specific learning needs and peers offer to teach them for a fee.
cardSummary: Connects students with paid peer tutors, with topic requests, direct messaging, and reviews.
